# Nepa

> Growth by insights. Nepa is a Swedish marketing research company that turns complex data into actionable brand and marketing insights — combining brand tracking, marketing mix modelling, and campaign evaluation into one continuous platform.

Nepa helps brands unlock growth through marketing research insight, researching more than 50 markets globally, tracking 7,500+ brands and campaigns daily, and working with 300+ blue-chip clients annually. Nepa AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market (ticker: NEPA, ISIN: SE0008066302), with Redeye AB as Certified Adviser.

## Products
- Brand Tracking: Continuously updated brand health dashboard measuring awareness, perception, and purchase intent, with AI-powered trend detection and competitor benchmarking. Plans start from 15,000 SEK/month.
- Marketing Mix Modelling: Quantifies the short-term sales impact and long-term brand-building effect of each marketing channel and campaign, refreshed weekly or monthly, with a budget planning tool.
- Campaign Pulse: Rapid campaign evaluation benchmarked against 2,800+ campaigns, results typically within days of fieldwork.
- Brand Touch: Maps brand personality across 120 emotional attributes and 8 personality segments relative to competitors.
- Brand Assets: Measures the fame, uniqueness, and competitive spill-over of a brand's distinctive assets (logos, colors, slogans, mascots).
- Brand Premium: Quantifies brand equity as a measurable KPI showing how much consumers believe a brand is worth versus competitors.
- Market Segmentation: Bespoke consumer segmentation models based on demographics, behaviour, needs, and values.
- Category Insight: Ad hoc market analysis of category structure, consumer behaviour, and competitive benchmarking.
- Paths to Purchase: Maps the full non-linear consumer journey across touchpoints, quantifying each touchpoint's conversion impact.
- Creative AI Analytics: AI analysis of ad creative features (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, YouTube) linked to cost per acquisition, not just engagement.
- Category Entry Points: Identifies the cues consumers use to recall a brand during a buying decision, to build mental availability.

## Solutions
- Marketing Strategy: Clarifies what to say, to whom, and when, using audience motivation and timing data.
- Brand Development: Builds distinctive, consistent brands by tracking performance and emotional connection over time.
- Visual Performance: Measures how creative and visual assets perform in real time across every channel.
- Media Strategy: Identifies which channels and touchpoints drive results so investment focuses where it pays back.
- Campaign Measurement: Tracks how campaigns build awareness, consideration, and preference in real time, mid-flight.

## Industries Served
- FMCG & Consumer Goods, Finance & Insurance, Fashion & Retail, Retail & E-commerce, Pharma, Media & Entertainment, Telecom, SaaS/Platforms

## Key Results / Proof Points
- Fashion retailer: +20% baseline sales, +16% actual annual sales after identifying and correcting declining brand health and an imbalanced media mix (no client name disclosed).
- Cure Media & Akademibokhandeln: 63% of followers reached by campaign, 79% liking, 27% purchase-intent lift from creator marketing.
- Hemköp: +36% brand attribution, +29% ad liking, +19% preference, +8% purchase intent after a Brand Asset Study-led visual identity redesign.
- Wolt (Creative AI Analytics on TikTok): up to 40%+ potential CPA reduction identified by moving from current to best-practice ad creative.
- Dafgårds: 600% increase in marketing investment, backed by confidence from Category Insight and Brand Tracking data, supporting a return to category leadership.
